trials.label: R21/Matrix-M in African Children Against Clinical Malaria
registered_primaries: Efficacy: To assess the protective efficacy of R21/Matrix-M against clinical malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum, in 5-36 month old children living in a malaria endemic area, 12 months after completion of the primary course.

Safety: To assess the safety and reactogenicity of R21/Matrix-M, in both vaccination regimes, of children living in a malaria endemic area, in the month following each vaccination, and 12 months after completion of the primary course.
School age booster extension: To assess the protective efficacy of R21/Matrix-M against clinical malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum in school- age children in Burkina Faso and Mali

School age booster extension: to assess the safety and reactogenicity of an additional late booster of R21/Matrix-M, in school age children living in Burkina Faso and Mali, one month after vaccination

primary.poolable_reason: 3 TRIALS, AND NO TWO SHARE A REGISTERED PRIMARY OUTCOME FAMILY. Registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: NCT00866619, NCT03896724, NCT04704830. Their registered primaries are recorded per trial on this object and do not reduce to a common quantity, so there is nothing for two of them to estimate in common. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.' -- and Handbook 6.5 section 10.10.3, 'A systematic review need not contain any meta-analyses.'

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor -- each is registered and reports its own primary. NOT that the drug or intervention is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that the question this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials this page carries. THE CRITICISM IS OF THE POOLING AND OF NOTHING ELSE -- a trial that registers the endpoints it was designed to measure is behaving correctly. The registry is a live document and this reads its contents on the date recorded; a later amendment could change it. If a further eligible trial is identified, this verdict should be revisited.

risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades trials contributing to a pooled result; this page publishes none.
